 About Sri Lanka vs Hong Kong, China 7th Place Play-off
 The Sri Lanka vs Hong Kong, China 7th Place Play-off in the HK Sixes, 2026 delivered an exciting contest at Mission Road Ground, Mong Kok on 01 November 2026, with both teams showcasing strong performances with bat and ball. Batting first, Hong Kong, China put up 119/0 (6.0) on the board, thanks to a solid knock from Anshy Rath, who scored 51 runs, while Babar Hayat provided valuable support. In reply, Sri Lanka fought hard and reached 118/4 (6.0), with Muditha Lakshan leading the chase with an important contribution. With the ball, Sangeeth Cooray and Yasim Murtaza made a significant impact by picking up crucial wickets and controlling the run flow at key moments. This stats page gives fans a complete breakdown of batting and bowling performances, partnerships, strike rates, economy rates, and key match moments from the HK Sixes, 2026, helping readers understand how the game unfolded.
